categories.main_business_segments: NOV operates through three primary business segments: Wellbore Technologies, Completion & Production Solutions, and Rig Technologies. Wellbore Technologies provides equipment and services for drilling operations; Completion & Production Solutions focuses on technologies for well completion and production; and Rig Technologies designs and manufactures drilling rigs and related equipment, including solutions for both oil & gas and renewable energy markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: NOV leverages proprietary technologies in drilling automation, predictive analytics, condition-based maintenance, and digital solutions such as the MaxTM platform. Manufacturing processes include machining, welding, fabrication, assembly, and testing, with a focus on alloy steel and advanced composites. The company also develops specialized equipment for geothermal, wind, and carbon capture applications, and integrates digital monitoring and control systems across its product lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: NOV's customers are predominantly oilfield service companies, drilling contractors, energy producers (including major, national, and independent oil & gas companies), and shipyards. The company also serves industrial, municipal, and renewable energy markets, including offshore wind and geothermal developers. Its products and services are used throughout the drilling, completion, and production phases of oil, gas, and renewable energy projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: NOV operates in 62 countries with significant operations in the United States, Middle East, Africa, Latin America, Far East, Canada, and Europe. Approximately 64% of its 2022 revenues were generated outside the U.S., and it maintains a global manufacturing, service, and distribution footprint with over 550 facilities worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: NOV is primarily an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and technology provider, operating downstream in the supply chain by delivering finished equipment, systems, and aftermarket services directly to end users and service providers. The company also provides aftermarket support, spare parts, and digital services for its large installed base.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: NOV's strategic priorities include advancing proprietary technologies to lower the cost and environmental impact of energy production, supporting the energy transition, and capitalizing on economies of scale. R&D efforts focus on automation, digitalization, predictive analytics, renewable energy solutions (offshore/onshore wind, geothermal, carbon capture), and sustainability initiatives. The company emphasizes a capital-light, scalable business model and continuous innovation to maintain technology leadership.
categories.revenue_model: NOV generates revenue primarily through the sale and rental of equipment, product sales, aftermarket parts and services, and long-term construction contracts. Additional revenue streams include digital solutions, licensing, and service contracts, with some recurring revenue from aftermarket support and monitoring services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: NOV competes with large publicly traded oilfield service and equipment companies, as well as smaller independent manufacturers in oil & gas, industrial, and renewable energy markets. It positions itself as the leading independent global provider of energy technology and equipment, with unmatched scale, scope, and a reputation for reliability and innovation. The company is differentiated by its broad product portfolio, global reach, and OEM aftermarket support.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, NOV generated $7.24 billion in revenue, up 31% from 2021, reflecting a strong recovery in oil & gas activity and growth in international and renewable markets. The company reported an operating profit of $264 million and net income of $155 million, reversing prior year losses. NOV maintains a strong balance sheet with $1.07 billion in cash and a conservative capital structure, positioning it for continued growth and resilience through industry cycles.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: NOV delivers value through its comprehensive technology portfolio, global service infrastructure, and ability to provide integrated solutions that enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability for energy producers. Its large installed base, OEM aftermarket support, and digital capabilities (e.g., MaxTM platform) offer customers reduced downtime, lower total cost of ownership, and improved operational performance. NOV's commitment to innovation and energy transition solutions further differentiates it in both traditional and emerging energy markets.
